equations.name: Front wheel travel
equations.riderMeaning: How far the front tyre has moved vertically — what the road feels, not just fork stroke.
publicRefs: Motorcycle chassis kinematics: vertical wheel travel through fork rake

equations.name: Front wheel rate
equations.riderMeaning: The spring rate the front tyre feels. Geometry changes can move this even without changing springs.
publicRefs: Virtual work: angled fork spring to vertical wheel rate

equations.name: Front wheel force
equations.riderMeaning: Vertical spring force at the front contact — sanity-check against corner weights.
publicRefs: Force resolution along fork axis to vertical

equations.name: Rear wheel force
equations.riderMeaning: Vertical spring force at the rear contact after the linkage.

equations.name: Rear wheel rate
equations.riderMeaning: The spring rate the rear tyre feels. Linkage ratio enters squared.
publicRefs: Linkage: wheel rate = spring rate / MR^2

section8.note: Uses instantaneous MR definition; displayed ZC rates may use local average MR

equations.name: Rear wheel travel
equations.riderMeaning: Vertical rear wheel movement for the current shock stroke and linkage ratio.

section8.note: Guide lists Rw travel 44.4 mm — local MR may differ from displayed 2.07

equations.name: Rear normal trail
equations.riderMeaning: How strongly rear lateral force can steer the chassis (rear-steer effect).
publicRefs: Steering geometry: rear normal trail construction

equations.name: Load-transfer angle
equations.riderMeaning: How hard throttle tries to squat the rear, from mass height over wheelbase.
publicRefs: Cossalter / Foale: load transfer angle atan(h/L)

equations.name: Anti-squat percent
equations.riderMeaning: Near 100% holds rear height under drive; under 100% squats; over 100% extends. Needs a trustworthy CoG for the percent.

equations.name: Static weight split
equations.riderMeaning: Static load split. Front-biased aids turn-in; rear share matters for drive grip.
publicRefs: Statics: axle load share from horizontal CoG

equations.name: Spring rate centre
equations.riderMeaning: Where combined wheel-rate stiffness is centred. Compare to CoG X for pitch balance.
publicRefs: Spring rate centre from front/rear wheel rates
